judged_text: EmbedController#best enqueues a retrieve job and renders 'loading' for any embed_url on the embeddable host, with no validation that the URL is well-formed or reachable before enqueueing. Arbitrary garbage URLs matching the host are pushed into sidekiq where TopicRetriever must reject them; the referrer-only host check means any page on the embeddable host can enqueue unlimited retrieval jobs (the 60s throttle only applies per-URL to non-staff users), letting a page spam the job queue and outbound fetches.

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, the only guard before enqueueing Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url) is ensure_embeddable, which validates only request.referer host against SiteSetting.embeddable_host (and does not validate params[:embed_url] at all). Thus any request with a matching Referer host can enqueue a Sidekiq job for arbitrary embed_url strings (including many distinct garbage URLs), and TopicRetriever’s throttle is per-URL (retrieved:#{@embed_url}) with a 60s TTL, so varying the URL bypasses throttling and can drive unbounded job creation/outbound fetch attempts (TopicEmbed.import_remote open(url).read). This is a diff-grounded queue-spam / resource-exhaustion vulnerability.
